name: CoDerx Job Board
author: Mehbub Hossen Fahim

sections.description:
CoDerx Job Board turns your WordPress site into a job circular board. Visitors browse and filter jobs; there is no application form, so candidates contact your agency by phone, WhatsApp or email.

Features

  • Job Circulars post type with Countries and Job Categories
  • Company name and job type fields
  • Salary (currency, min, max, period), vacancies, deadline, gender, age, experience, contract, duty hours, benefits and requirements
  • Automatic “days left” and “Expired” status from the deadline, using the site timezone
  • Expired jobs can be shown with a badge, hidden, or moved to draft automatically
  • AJAX filters: keyword, country tabs, category and sorting, with numbered pages or a Load more button
  • Five job card styles: Classic, Minimal, List row, Dark and Soft
  • Single job page with overview, perks, description, requirements, sticky summary, contact box (call, WhatsApp, email), share links, related jobs and a fake-agent notice
  • Country cards shortcode with live open job counts and a Show more button
  • Google JobPosting structured data
  • Admin tools: reference numbers, sortable columns, filters, duplicate job, bulk urgent, demo data importer
  • Works with classic and block themes, and supports template overrides

Shortcodes

  • [ojhub_jobs] – job list with search, country tabs and filters
  • [ojhub_jobs_simple] – job cards only, no filters
  • [ojhub_jobs per_page="6" filters="no" pagination="none"] – compact block for a homepage
  • [ojhub_jobs country="qatar"] – jobs for one country
  • [ojhub_countries] – country cards (use limit="6" to show 6 cards and a Show more button)

Template overrides

Copy any file from the plugin’s templates folder into an coderx-job-board folder inside your theme or child theme to customize it.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Job Circulars > Settings and add your contact phone, WhatsApp number and email.
  4. Create a page with the [ojhub_jobs] shortcode and select it as the Jobs page in the settings.
  5. Add jobs under Job Circulars > Add New.
sections.faq:
Is there an application form?

No. Each job shows your agency’s phone, WhatsApp and email so candidates contact you directly.

How do I show only some country cards on the homepage?

Use [ojhub_countries limit="6"]. The remaining cards appear when the visitor clicks Show more.

Does the plugin send data to any external service?

No. The share buttons on a job page are plain links to Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and X. Nothing is sent until a visitor clicks one.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Nothing is removed unless you enable “Delete all data on uninstall” in the settings.

I used an earlier version named Monjil Job Circulars.

Your jobs, countries, categories, settings and shortcodes are migrated automatically the first time version 1.3.0 loads.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Renamed to “CoDerx Job Board” (slug coderx-job-board) at the WordPress.org Plugins Team’s request so the distinctive identifier “CoDerx” leads the name. Text domain and the theme template-override folder follow the new slug. Existing jobs, settings and shortcodes keep working; the internal ojhub prefix is unchanged.

1.5.0

  • Renamed to “Job Hub CoDerx” (slug job-hub-coderx) for a shorter, brandable name. Text domain and the theme template-override folder followed the new slug. Existing jobs, settings and shortcodes kept working; the internal ojhub prefix was unchanged.
  • Hardened admin actions: nonce verification added to settings saving and country term saving; JobPosting schema JSON now escapes safely.

1.4.0

  • Renamed to “Fahim12 Overseas Recruitment Board” for a distinctive, trademark-safe name. Text domain and the theme template-override folder followed the new slug. Existing jobs, settings and shortcodes kept working; the internal ojhub prefix was unchanged.
  • Hardened admin actions: nonce verification added to settings saving and country term saving; JobPosting schema JSON now escapes safely.

1.3.0

  • Renamed to Overseas Job Hub. Internal names now use the ojhub prefix. Data from earlier versions is migrated automatically.
  • Country cards: the limit now includes the Higher Education card, and the Show more button text stays readable on hover.
  • Security and WordPress.org compliance review: input sanitizing, escaping and readme updates.

1.2.0

  • Country tab “Others” can be shown last, normally or hidden.
  • Five job card styles.

1.1.0

  • Filter tabs editor, country images, company name and job type fields, and the [ojhub_jobs_simple] shortcode.

1.0.0

  • First release.

screenshots.caption: Job list page with country tabs, keyword search, category filter and sorting. Job cards show country, category, salary, vacancies, perks and a deadline countdown. The first card is marked Urgent, the last one is Expired.

Single job page with a full overview (vacancies, salary, deadline, gender, age, experience, contract, duty hours), perks, description, requirements list, a sticky contact box (call, WhatsApp, email) and a fake-agent warning notice.

Country cards produced by the [ojhub_countries] shortcode. Each card shows the live open-job count and links to the filtered job list for that country. A Show more button reveals the remaining countries.

Admin Settings page (General tab) with the plugin's seven tabs: General, Job Page, Contact Box, Appearance, Filter Tabs, Tools and Shortcodes & Help. The Appearance tab offers five job card styles and brand color pickers.
